name: Opendirectory
description: A comprehensive registry of 28+ Go-To-Market, Technical Marketing, and Growth Automation skills. This plugin empowers Claude with specialized, pre-configured capabilities for SEO research, technical content generation, competitive intelligence monitoring, and automated outbound workflows.
longDescription:
Ships **59 skills**.

- **Skills** (59): `app-store-review-arbitrage` (Fetches low-star App Store and Google Play reviews, clusters them into broken-promise patterns, and generates a ranked copy…), `blog-cover-image-cli` (Use when the user asks to generate a blog cover image, thumbnail, or article header), `brand-alchemy` (World-class brand strategist and naming expert), `claude-md-generator` (Use when the user asks to generate or update a project's CLAUDE or AGENTS context file from a…), `cold-email-verifier` (Use when the user wants to verify cold emails, enrich a lead list, or autonomously guess email addresses…), `company-radar` (Competitive intelligence orchestrator tracking companies across 8+ platforms (GitHub, Twitter, Reddit, HN, PH, YC Jobs) with heat scores…), `competitor-pr-finder` (Give it your product URL or description), `cook-the-blog` (Generate high-converting, deep-dive growth case studies in MDX format), and 51 more

Installs with `claude plugin install opendirectory@claude-community` from `Varnan-Tech/opendirectory`.
